user.title: S8 OMNI
user.description: Local connection to S8 OMNI over Tuya LAN.

data_description.local_key: The device Local Key. It is stored in the Home Assistant config entry and is never sent to the cloud by this integration.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure S8 OMNI connection
reconfigure.description: Update the local connection parameters. Home Assistant verifies the new values against the robot before saving them.

data_description.device_id: The Device ID must remain the same for this config entry.
data_description.local_key: Use this field after the robot has been re-paired and Tuya has issued a new Local Key.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to S8 OMNI with these parameters.

abort.reconfigure_successful: S8 OMNI connection settings were updated successfully.
abort.wrong_device: The Device ID does not match this S8 OMNI config entry.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant polls the robot over the local network. The integration reloads automatically after this value changes.
